steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for this test.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ and use whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product and quantity; product selection also drives the mapped-vendor invitation flow.
Confirm the requested product is on the pricing sheet.
Confirm the requested quantity.
Choose the required delivery location.
Confirm the delivery location was retained.
Use the product mapping to add every mapped vendor.
Add the specifically named Vendor C through the participant search.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the default start-now behavior.
Publish the completed single-stage RFQ.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list.
Locate the named vendor in the participant list.
Assert that Vendor C is an invited participant on the published stage.
Confirm that the published stage has participants; the exact mapped-vendor total is dynamic.
